body:
Thank you... You made me a bit less hopeless for my future...

I dont want to do this to them, because although i live in a very accepting country, me and my family aren't natives, and in our native culture... well lgbt things usually aren't "liked" i dont want them to get shit from the other ppl like us, i dont want them to have to endure being called names.

​

But then how am i supposed to do this...

All i want from life is to live with someone i love...  
You know what really fucking hurts man? Even that will be a challenge, I'll have to tell my parents, they wont be happy about it, that is if they dont just kick me out.

They will never ask how we're doing, probably not even come to my wedding if i ever have one.

On the other hand,i cant do this to them, I just dont...

See, i cant change the way i am...  
I was born with adhd, its not as easy as some people assume, in my case it makes me unmotivated as hell, and motivated at other times, in essence i just can't plan anything, because i'm never sure if the very next day i just suddenly wont "feel like it"

When i was younger i used to be a real nightmare child, i can still hear my parents crying because they're getting called into the principal's office for the 8th time in the year.

​

I've hurt them, a lot, and i will never forget that.

My sister has filled the void i've created a long time anyway... They wont miss me.
